title: Broncos HC Sean Payton tells reporters that he doesn’t believe that CB Pat Surtain II or WR Pat Bryant will be placed on the IR

sources.title: Broncos HC Sean Payton tells reporters that he doesn’t believe that CB Pat Surtain II or WR Pat Bryant will be placed on the IR
sources.description: Denver Broncos head coach Sean Payton met with the media today and gave an update on some notable injuries. He provided some good news and told reporters that neither cornerback Pat Surtain II nor wide receiver Pat Bryant is expected to land on the season-ending or short-term injured reserve.
